svg.title: A workflow runs from folders a person chooses through an offline scan and an opt-in network lookup to a dashboard, a policy result and candidate events.
svg.desc: Moving figure, 10 seconds, looping, no sound. 1. Product label: SUPPLY CHAIN GRAPH · FROM FOLDERS TO EVIDENCE. 2. Process, 6 steps: 1. Choose project roots (picker, path or discovery), trigger, lane YOU; 2. Offline scan (no install, no remote fetch), action, lane THE TOOL; 3. Advisory lookups (shares package names), action, lane NETWORK, OPT-IN; 4. Graph dashboard (four lenses, start here), action, lane THE TOOL; 5. Evaluate policy (freshness, coverage, IDs), action, lane THE TOOL; 6. Candidate events (no alerts sent), end, lane THE TOOL. Links: Choose project roots to Offline scan; Offline scan to Graph dashboard; Offline scan to Advisory lookups, conditional, labelled opt in; Advisory lookups to Graph dashboard, conditional; Graph dashboard to Evaluate policy; Evaluate policy to Candidate events. 3. Status line: You name the folders; there is no whole-computer search. 4. Choose project roots runs. 5. Offline scan runs. 6. Status line: The scan reads manifests, locks and imports, offline. 7. Advisory lookups runs. 8. Status line: Only this step sends package names, and only if you opt in. 9. Graph dashboard runs. 10. Status line: Edges keep their scope and file evidence. 11. Evaluate policy runs. 12. Status line: A source import alone does not prove an installed version. 13. Candidate events runs. 14. Status line: Unknown is not clean: unqueried, failed, unsupported, stale. 15. Every step returns to waiting.

g.text: SUPPLY CHAIN GRAPH · FROM FOLDERS TO EVIDENCE
You name the folders; there is no whole-computer search
The scan reads manifests, locks and imports, offline
Only this step sends package names, and only if you opt in
Edges keep their scope and file evidence
A source import alone does not prove an installed version
Unknown is not clean: unqueried, failed, unsupported, stale
